meta.title: Two bids: award a split: 6 units to B and 4 units to A; approver rejects
gaps: Prepare or observe two bids from Vendor A and Vendor B in the prepared state
Allocate exactly 6 units to Vendor B and 4 units to Vendor A
Verify Vendor B's 6 × 90 = 540, Vendor A's 4 × 100 = 400, and total 940
Create and submit the award proposal with the required proposal fields
Log in as the approver and reject the proposal with a remark
Verify that no purchase order is created after rejection
Verify that the buyer can start awarding again from Master QCS

Reach the awarding screen, the closest available screen for the requested allocation.
